subject: FinTechCorp - security discovery & incident response follow-up
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-21T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: FinTechCorp - security discovery & incident response follow-up

Hi Ana — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

- SOC 2 status: you mentioned FinTechCorp is working toward SOC 2 Type II; please confirm current status and expected completion (quarter).
- Incident response / breach notification: can you confirm your internal SLA for notifying customers and the escalation contact we should use? We typically collect time-to-notify expectations (e.g., 24/48/72h windows) for our contracts.
- BCP / DR evidence: could you share a short summary of your BCP/DR plan and the date of your last DR test? A one-page summary or internal slide is fine.
- Vendor security questionnaire: we can send our standard questionnaire, or if you have a shared vendor portal please send link/ID and we will complete it.

Attachments: none on my side yet — I can attach our security overview and SOC bridge letter after I get confirmation on what you'd like to receive.

Proposed timeline: if possible, please provide the SOC status and a short BCP/DR summary by EOW (Friday). We'll follow up with the questionnaire and any additional evidence requests as needed.

Thanks — appreciate the quick alignment.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0182
From: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@fintechcorp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos@fintechcorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp - security discovery & incident response follow-up

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below: 

- SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type I attestation in 2024. We are currently in the audit cycle for SOC 2 Type II and expect the report to be finalized in Q3 2026 (target: mid-September). I can share the Type I report and a summary of coverage in my next email.

- Incident response / breach notification: our internal IR policy requires we notify affected customers within 72 hours for incidents that materially impact customer data or availability. For incidents that trigger regulatory reporting requirements, we escalate internally and aim to notify within 48–72 hours depending on the regulator timeline. Point of contact for IR escalation: Carlos Ruiz (Head of Security) — carlos@fintechcorp.com, +1 (617) 555-0104.

- BCP / DR: We have a documented BCP/DR plan; last tabletop exercise was March 2026 and the last failover DR test was August 2025. I will attach a 1–2 page summary and our DR test log.

- Vendor questionnaire: we use a shared vendor portal (security@fintechcorp.com) for initial intake — I will create a questionnaire request and send you a portal link and an internal questionnaire ID by EOD tomorrow. Alternatively, if you prefer we can accept a completed PDF questionnaire; please send your standard questionnaire and we'll complete it.

Let me know if you need anything else. I will attach the SOC1/Type I report and the BCP/DR summary in my follow-up.

Best,
Ana Gomez
Security Program Manager | FinTechCorp
ana.gomez@fintechcorp.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-21T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp - security discovery & incident response follow-up

Ana — perfect, thanks for the details and the IR contact. For clarity on the evidence we'll need to proceed with procurement and security approval at Redwood, could you provide the following items (PDFs or Drive links preferred):

1) Most recent SOC report (Type I is fine for now) + expected SOC 2 Type II completion date
2) BCP / DR summary (1–2 pages) and last DR test date and outcome
3) Incident response policy snippet that describes customer notification timelines and who is notified internally (major contacts)
4) Any encryption/KMS details you can share (at a high level) and whether customer data is encrypted at rest in your environment

We will also initiate our vendor security questionnaire on our side so you can see what we ask — attaching two stubs: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf (high-level) and SOC2_Bridge_Letter.pdf (explains our covered controls/attestations). Please treat these as placeholders until we receive your SOC/BCP docs.

If it's helpful, here's a proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- By 2026-06-25: FinTechCorp sends questionnaire link + SOC1 (Type I) and BCP/DR summary
- By 2026-06-30: Redwood to review and request any follow-up evidence (if needed)
- By 2026-07-14: Decision point for procurement/PO / next steps

Thanks again — I'll attach our two docs now.

Regards,
Evelyn

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf, SOC2_Bridge_Letter.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-22T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp - security discovery & incident response follow-up (internal)

Internal only — quick note on approach: 

Evelyn, good breakdown. Let's propose the MAP Evelyn outlined and make sure legal sees the proposed 72-hour notification window. Marissa — can you prepare our standard vendor attestation language to share in case they ask for contractual commitments on breach notification timelines? If SOC2 Type II is only available mid-September, we should be prepared to accept Type I + additional compensating controls (e.g., evidence of DR tests, IR runbook excerpt) for the initial go-live.

Also propose we offer a short SOC bridge letter from Redwood if they need a reciprocal statement for any gaps. Happy to join the next call if they push back on timelines.

— Jordan
From: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@fintechcorp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos@fintechcorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp - security discovery & incident response follow-up

Evelyn — thanks, we will follow the MAP. Attached are the items I mentioned: FinTechCorp_BCP_DR_Summary.docx (1-page summary) and FinTechCorp_SOC2_TypeI_2024.pdf (Type I report).

We will also: 
- Create the vendor portal request and send you the intake link + questionnaire ID by EOD today.
- Confirm SOC 2 Type II timeline (final audit report expected mid-September 2026).
- Confirm that our internal IR escalation process aims to notify affected customers within 72 hours for incidents materially affecting customer data; for incidents requiring regulator notification we escalate and try to notify within 48–72 hours depending on jurisdiction.

If Redwood can accept Type I + BCP summary + IR policy snippet for procurement in the short term, we should be able to move forward while we finish the Type II audit. If legal requires contract language around breach timelines, please loop your legal team and we can align on reasonable commitments.

Regards,
Ana

Attachments: FinTechCorp_BCP_DR_Summary.docx, FinTechCorp_SOC2_TypeI_2024.pdf
